The *Abhijjamānapetavatthu* ("Without Rippling", Pv 26) is a narrative poem preserved in the *Petavatthu* within the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The core theme of the work emphasizes that acts of generosity lead directly to happiness and beneficial karmic consequences [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs four translations of the text across four languages [SuttaCentral].
